title: Tabletop Soccer Game, 6 Balls – First to 10 Points Wins
seo_title: Tabletop Soccer Game, 6 Balls – Two Players, First to 10
seo_description: Tabletop soccer game with rails, shooting handles, goals and score counter. 6 balls, two players, ages 3+. First to reach 10 points wins.
descriptionHtml:
Indoor soccer ends with a lamp getting hit

A real ball bounces off tables, glass and lamps as soon as a match kicks off indoors. After a couple of kicks someone usually says stop, and the ball ends up in a box again.

A pitch with rails keeps the balls on the table

The soccer pitch has rails all around, shooting handles, goals and flag posts, plus a score counter to keep track. Age-rated 3+ on the box. Two players face off with six balls, and whoever reaches 10 points first wins, according to the rule on the box.

Features

  • 6 balls in the box – the match keeps going without anyone having to look for a lost ball.
  • Rails around the whole pitch – the balls stay on the table instead of bouncing away.
  • Shooting handles for both players – the ball is steered by hand, nobody kicks with a foot.
  • First to 10 points wins – the match has a clear end according to the rule on the box.
  • Score counter included – nobody has to keep track in their head of who is in the lead.

The box and instructions are in English – no Swedish manual is included.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
